==Description==
'''Legacy Dusty Bridges''' is meant to be a community map which uses the second version of [[Dusty Bridges]]. However, due to developer oversight, it is not a community map and is instead completely unplayable. an elevated desert [[Maps|map]]

==Design & Path==
The current version of '''Dusty Bridges''' takes place above a desert plain, elevated above a sandstorm. The map itself is quite mountainous, with stone rocks dominating the landscape. There are various stone pillars. In terms of human habitation, there are very few buildings or man-made objects.

The sand path begins and ends at two mineshaft entrances. It crosses between various stone pillars and mountains on high wooden bridges.

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Hard|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*There is little ground space for towers on this map. Try to cluster towers together.
**Due to the somewhat short path, the [[DJ Booth]] is recommended to boost the range of towers.
**The optimum space to place towers is near the middle mounds. Here, you can maximize the range of towers.
*Cliff space is somewhat limited. Try to minimize the amount of [[Ranger]]s and [[Mortar]]s placed down if there are more than two people.
**You can place cliff towers on flat pebble spots on the mountains.
**It is mostly recommended to place cliff towers on the hill at the back.
*Due to the map design and short path, short-ranged towers such as the [[Warden]] may not be recommended.
